description: Like a comment, or unlike with `unlike: true`. A call that did not go through returns `done: false` with a `reason`. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

instant.description: Optional. Skip INSSIST's action pacing and run now — use only when the user asked for an unspaced or burst action.

unlike.description: True to remove a like; default false.

name: comment_like
title: Comment like
